name: – Billy Kelleher – § 3/2
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: ‘stresses that employment, housing and income insecurities, as well as unpaid care responsibilities, deepen gender inequalities in health and limit access to timely, quality and affordable care; points out that inequalities are also evident in gender-specific conditions, as research into these conditions has been repeatedly undervalued and underfunded; notes that stigma, the visibility of symptoms and cultural perceptions of disease can further exacerbate barriers to timely diagnosis and care for women;’
